summary: Myriad Genetics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on November 5, 2026, disclosing that on November 2, 2026 it detected unauthorized access within its information technology network. The company activated incident response, temporarily suspended testing operations and order management systems, reset certain credentials, and engaged external experts; most systems have returned to normal operations. Management stated it does not currently believe the incident will have a material adverse effect, though scope and possible patient-record access remain under investigation. No deal terms, advisor, or board recommendation; watch regulatory, legal, and reputational fallout.
